name: hexagon-pattern
title: Hexagon Pattern
description: A honeycomb of hairline hexagons drawn as one repeating SVG pattern, with optional filled cells and an edge fade.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of each hexagon in pixels, centre to corner.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between neighbouring hexagons in pixels.

props.name: direction
props.description: Flat-top hexagons in columns, or pointy-top hexagons in rows.

props.name: highlight
props.description: [column, row] pairs of hexagons to fill in the primary color.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the honeycomb out towards the edges.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
